title: SheffieldSolarTabularResponse
description: The column-oriented envelope every Sheffield Solar PV_Live, PV_Live_EU and PV_Forecast data endpoint returns: a meta array naming the columns, and a data array of positional rows. Derived from the institution's own OpenAPI at https://api.solar.sheffield.ac.uk/openapi.json and from live probed responses on 2026-08-30.

meta.description: Ordered column names for each row in data.

data.description: Rows of values, positionally aligned to meta.
